newsitem.title: PERU: Lima shares edge higher by close in mixed session.
newsitem.headline: Lima shares edge higher by close in mixed session.

text.p: Lima shares edged slightly higher overall by the close in a mixed session marked by demand for benchmark Telefonica del Peru and correction in the prices of some other leaders, brokers said.
They forecast a similar tendency on Wednesday, with foreign investor interest in public service stocks likely to keep the indexes up overall.
"Today the bolsa registered a moderate rise due to the demand for Telefonica by local and foreign investors," said Luis Ramirez, of Macrovalores brokerage.
On Tuesday, the General Index rose 0.19 percent to 1,416.99 points, while the blue-chip Selective Index advanced 0.47 percent to 1,926.58.
Telefonica rose 2.16 percent to 5.67 soles on 2.7 million shares. Total market volume was 40.4 million soles ($16.3 million) as 22 stocks rose, 37 fell and 35 were flat.

Telefonica's gains were offset by technical corrections in the electric and mining sectors. Electricity distributor Edelnor, for example, lost 2.44 percent to 3.20 soles on 238,912 shares, while Luz del Sur was off 0.56 sol to 3.47 soles on 872,265 shares.
Mariano Prado, of MGS y Asociados brokerage, said the electricity stocks were correcting themselves after recent sharp rises. "It seems they are finding their balance."

Miner Southern Ltd was off 2.03 percent to 14.50 soles on 21,301 shares, while Buenaventura dipped 0.48 percent to 20.90 soles on 17,172 shares and Atacocha lost 3.03 percent to 0.32 soles on 607,218 shares traded.
-- Marco Aquino, Lima newsroom, 511 221-2134 REUTER AC
